problems: No bowl, no water, no lily pad and no spike show up in any frame of the storyboard or the three full-size frames. The film shows only a grass patch with a boulder, a blue hydrangea bush and a pink flower.

No magnet stone is visible being carried. The only thing that moves is a yellow bird walking from right to left (storyboard frames 6-13). Its body is cut off by the top edge, so only its legs and tail feathers show, and it carries nothing anyone can see.
Because there is no needle, nothing can be seen to turn or react when the stone goes by. The 'compass' in the caption never appears.
The camera frames the wrong place. The walker's head and body are out of frame at the top (full-size frame at 50%), and the first 5 and last 3 storyboard frames are an empty, static meadow.
The light is dim and murky. Most of the foreground is dark green shadow and the subject stays in it.
posts.critique: The caption describes a floating magnetised spike reacting to a magnet stone, but the film shows a bird's legs walking past a bush and a flower, and none of the objects it names. The caption claims a whole experiment that the pictures do not contain.
